title: metadata-protocol: give getMetaTypes() a named composed return type, held equal to main's emitted d.ts by a type-equality pin (#25467 E1 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

Source: the seat ruling on #25467 step E1 (PR #29488, merged as `8118be4bec`). `getMetaTypes()`'s explicit return type was moved out of E1.

`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.getMetaTypes()` has an inferred return type that emits 793 lines of `.d.ts`. Pasting it inline as a literal would keep the d.ts identical but duplicate 793 lines that drift silently. Keeping it inferred lets the declaration emitter print a class comment inside it (E0's seat record, item 5), so every E2 cut reads its raw d.ts block by hand.

**Ask (option B of the E1 report):** declare a named composed return type, built from the existing exported types, and add a type-equality pin (compile-time `Equal<>`) against the type main emits today. The d.ts text changes, but the type does not. Then retire the per-cut raw-diff reading.

`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, a patch changeset. Serial with the E2 cuts on `protocol.ts`: schedule it between two cuts, outside a freeze day.
